rules.title: Conjugation -ę, -isz / -ysz (-ić, -yć verbs; myśleć)
notes: After *sz, cz, rz, ż* write **y**, otherwise **i**. The same: *mówić, lubić, palić* (-isz); *kończyć, tańczyć* (-ysz).
Compare the -m, -sz group: *mam, masz* — but *mówię, mówisz*.

rules.title: Languages: three constructions
notes: *uczyć* = to teach (a teacher), *uczyć się* = to learn (a student).

rules.title: Adjectives: gender, as in Lesson 3
notes: After *k* and *g* the masculine ending is *-i*: *wysoki*, *niski*, *brzydki*.
